    # generate distinct short expressions like "a1", "a2", … using letters and digits
    letters = string.ascii_lowercase
    exprs = []
    for i in range(n):
        ch = letters[i % 26]
        num = i // 26
        exprs.append([f"{ch}{num}"])
    return exprs
